Output $(\widehat x,\widehat y)\in R_xB_2^{d_x}\times R_yB_2^{d_y}$. Arbitrary measurable transcript-based postprocessing is permitted, including an unqueried point, an average, or a convex combination, provided the output remains feasible. The function $f:\mathbb R^{d_x+d_y}\to\mathbb R$ is continuously differentiable, convex on $x$, and concave on $y$, with globally $\beta$-Lipschitz joint gradient. Bilinearity and a separate gradient-norm bound are not assumed.
